blocks.text: ANTIPOLO — Bella Belen continues her generational run in her second year in the Premier Volleyball League with a new career-high 35 points–the fifth most scored by a local player in a single game. Belen’s output on Thursday ranks behind Tots Carlos’ 38 points for Creamline, Savi Davison’s 37 for PLDT in the Invitational Conference and Alyssa Valdez’s 37 for Creamline in 2017, and the 36-point performances of Davison, Brooke Van Sickle and Kat Tolentino. Belen’s sensational game led Capital1 to a thrilling 28-26, 22-25, 25-15, 23-25, 21-19 win over Akari in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series at Ynares Center Antipolo […]...
